profile.summary: Horizon Industrial Parks Limited engaged in the business of developing, operating, and maintaining industrial and warehousing parks in India. It offers industrial and logistic parks, fulfillment centers and industrial facilities, and in-city centers. The company also offers turnkey solutions, energy solutions, on-site staff accommodation and skill development centers, cold storage, and hospitality
